items.author: Trump
items.text: It was just revealed that the REAL Numbers on the Economy, published before the Election, were FAKE, and a correction was issued yesterday by the people in the Government Agency that does these numbers. The American Economy under The Trump Administration is doing FAR BETTER than the good numbers already released. Third Quarter GDP Growth has now been corrected to be 4.3%, instead of 3.4%, a major difference! Why wasn’t the correct number issued before the Election? I am asking for an immediate investigation of this situation. This is not a small error, this is a massive, and purposeful, error.
items.summary_cn: 特朗普称美国第三季度GDP增速被上修至4.3%、明显强于此前公布的3.4%，并要求调查数据发布时点。
